evidence.title: Agility Robotics Selects Nyobolt as its Ultra-Fast Charging Battery Technology Partner for Digit 5
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore. AND CAMBRIDGE, UK, Oct. 15, 2026 — Agility Robotics , a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced that Nyobolt , a pioneer of high-power, ultra-fast charging solutions, is the technology provider to Agility. The technology powers one of Digit® 5’s most significant upgrades: a fast recharge battery system that enables Digit to work more than 20 hours in a 24-hour day. Agility recently unveiled Digit 5 as its first humanoid robot designed for cooperatively safe work at scale, allowing it to work in close proximity to people. As part of its upgrades, Digit 5 will feature a new battery system that delivers 90-minutes of runtime and charges in just 9 minutes, achieving a 10:1 run-to-charge ratio, up from Digit 4’s 2:1 ratio. This rapid charge capability is designed to keep Digit working, enabling more than two shifts in a single day and helping customers get more from each robot. “For our customers, Digit's uptime is the business case," said Daniel Diez, Chief Business Officer of Agility Robotics.
